name: Seated Figure-Four Stretch
steps: Sit upright near the front edge of a sturdy chair with both feet flat on the floor.
Cross one ankle smoothly over the opposite thigh just above the knee and let the crossed knee relax open to the side.
Keeping your back straight, hinge gently forward from your hips until you feel a deep stretch in the outer glute of your crossed leg.
Hold the stretch calmly while breathing slowly on one side, then sit tall and switch legs.
tips: Hinge from your hips with a flat spine instead of rounding your shoulders forward.
Let the crossed knee open under its own weight without pressing down on it.
